decision.reason: [ev-a56a8cf82a6c] is only a one-line changelog title. It says RBAC fine-grained inheritance is now disabled by default and marks the change as breaking (!), but it gives no details. It does not name the config key or setting that controls the behaviour, the before/after values, or which RBAC policies (for example, ones that rely on inherited fine-grained permissions) are exposed. It also does not say what happens to those policies if the operator does nothing. Writing applicability and consequence would need the linked PRs (#19988/#20671) or the 3.0 upgrade guide.
